army_rules.name: Combat Doctrines
army_rules.rules_text:
At the start of your Command phase, you can select one combat doctrine listed below. If you do, that combat doctrine is active for friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units with this ability until the start of your next Command phase. Unless otherwise stated, you can only select each combat doctrine once per battle, and only one combat doctrine can be active for each unit. If a rule makes a combat doctrine active for a unit, any combat doctrine previously active for it is no longer active for that unit.

ASSAULT DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make an Advance move, that Advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

DEVASTATOR DOCTRINE: This unit's ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

TACTICAL DOCTRINE: When this unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that Fall Back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot and eligible to declare a charge.

army_rules.name: Transhuman Strategist
army_rules.rules_text: At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

army_rules.name: Space Marine Chapters
army_rules.rules_text: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

army_rules.name: Librarius
army_rules.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER units with this ability have a psyker level of 1 or higher, specified in that unit's abilities. Each psychic ability has a psychic level of 1 or higher, specified in that ability's name. In a battle round, a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER unit can use a number of psychic abilities whose total psychic level does not exceed that PSYKER unit's psyker level.

army_rules.name: Special Move Types
army_rules.rules_text:
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE: Set-up distance 3". An eligible embarked unit that did not embark this phase can disembark wholly within 3" of its Transport, but cannot declare a charge until the end of the turn.

ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE: Set-up distance 3". An eligible embarked unit that did not embark this phase can disembark wholly within 3" of its Transport if that Transport has not Advanced or Fallen Back this phase.

army_rules.name: Kill Teams
army_rules.rules_text:
Each time an attack targets a KILL TEAM unit from your army that contains models with different Toughness characteristics, until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, use the Toughness characteristic of the majority of the models in that unit when determining what result is required for that attack to successfully wound. If two or more Toughness characteristics are tied for majority, use the highest Toughness characteristic.

For the purposes of determining which models can embark within a TRANSPORT model, KILL TEAM models follow the normal restrictions listed on the TRANSPORT model.

army_rules.name: Veteran Recruits
army_rules.rules_text: Your army cannot include the following ADEPTUS ASTARTES units: SCOUT SQUAD units; TERMINATOR SQUAD units; TERMINATOR ASSAULT SQUAD units.

chapter_rules.name: The Long Vigil
chapter_rules.rules_text: If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit's Chapter. You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army. Deathwatch armies cannot include Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

detachments.name: Black Spear Task Force

rule.name: Mission Tactics
rule.rules_text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:

FUROR TACTICS: If the Devastator Doctrine is active for your unit, your unit's attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

MALLEUS TACTICS: If the Tactical Doctrine is active for your unit, your unit's attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

PURGATUS TACTICS: If the Assault Doctrine is active for your unit, your unit's attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" have [PRECISION].

restrictions: Your army can include ADEPTUS ASTARTES DEATHWATCH units, but cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
With the exception of KILL TEAM CASSIUS (see Legends: Agents of the Imperium), your army cannot include any AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM DEATHWATCH units.

enhancements.name: The Thief of Secrets
enhancements.rules_text: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. This model has the following weapon: The Thief of Secrets (Melee, A 6, WS 2+, S 6, AP -3, D 2).
restrictions: WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN model only.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. If this unit is a KILL TEAM, this unit has Deep Strike. When you target this unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem, that use is -1CP.

enhancements.name: The Tome of Ectoclades
enhancements.rules_text: WATCH MASTER/CAPTAIN model only. Once per battle, per army, in your Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, the Assault Doctrine, Devastator Doctrine and Tactical Doctrine are active for this unit until the start of your next Command phase.
restrictions: WATCH MASTER or CAPTAIN model only.

enhancements.name: Osseus Key (Aura)
enhancements.rules_text: WATCH MASTER/TECHMARINE model only. While an enemy VEHICLE unit is within 6" of this model, that enemy unit's attacks have -1 A.
restrictions: WATCH MASTER or TECHMARINE model only.

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit.
stratagems.effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have +6" R and +1 S.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks (excluding [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks) have [ANTI-NON-VEHICLE 4+].

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KILL TEAM unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1 and have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.effect: Select one combat doctrine. That combat doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Site-to-site Teleportation
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Place your unit in Strategic Reserves. If your unit has KILL TEAM, your unit has Deep Strike until the end of your next Movement phase.

units.name: Deathwatch Terminator Squad

abilities.name: Terminus Assault
abilities.rules_text: This unit can re-roll Charge rolls. After this unit ends a Charge move, each enemy unit engaged with it must take a Battle-shock test, with -1 to that test for non-IMPERIUM/CHAOS units.

abilities.name: Teleport Homer
abilities.rules_text: At the start of the battle, set up one Teleport Homer token. When targeted with Rapid Ingress, you can use the token for a -1 CP reduction if setting up wholly within 3 inches of it and not within 3 inches of enemy models. Remove token if an enemy unit ends a move within 1 inch of it.
